note: Town of Milk River campground (8 Flags) just off Highway 4 beside the golf course, on a bend of the Milk River; the east row of sites lines the riverbank, the rest sit among trees on the gravel loop. Golf is $1 a hole for campers. --Claude

flags: GOOGLE: '8 Flags Campground' 4.3 stars / 83 reviews, 324 Railway St, point 49.14498,-112.08208.
BOOKING CHANGE: stored derived reservable true contradicted - the town says short stays are first come, first served for 2026.

LONG-STAY: weekly (C$120-180) and 28-day (C$400-600) packages are posted after the nightly rates, and imagery shows several units with sheds/decks along the river row - long-term occupancy present. Nightly rates lead and short stays are taken first come, so the long-stay tests pass on the page; reviewer may weigh how many river-row sites are monthly.

WATERFRONT (stored riverfront - keep, with caveat): imagery 0.16 m/px at 49.1454,-112.0808: the east row of RVs (along the river bend NE of the bridge) sits ~10 m from the top of the bank and ~15-20 m from the water, with only a strip of grass/low shrubs between and the internal road on the far (west) side. The other sites are on the treed loop 40-120 m back. Recommend riverfront with the note naming the east row (written).
